title: A kept re-name clears its claim's journal flags on an off-lock Engram read without rechecking
outcome: A kept (same-path, same-generation) re-name clears the holder's own journal flags (obsolete, retirement, an unsettled reconciliation) only when the authoritative Bound read still describes the journal's current state. A displacement or an unsettled reconciliation that arrived after the read, taken off the lock, is never erased.
acceptance: A regression changes the claim's journal (a Displaced retirement, or an unsettled reconciliation recorded) between the kept re-name's authoritative Engram read and its re-acquiring the state lock; the re-name does not clear that later flag, and evaluations under the binding stay refused until it is resolved.

A kept re-name whose read still matches the journal's state continues to clear the holder's own stale flags (the existing a_kept_re_name_clears_the_holders_own_stale_journal_flags behaviour is preserved).
Focused verification and the maintained gate pass on the final input.
